vapt.label: VAPT
vapt.subject: Penetration testing for {company}
vapt.offer: Rynex Security runs real-world attack simulations (VAPT) against web apps, APIs, networks and cloud environments, so weaknesses are found and fixed before an attacker finds them.
vapt.deliverable: You get a clear, prioritised report your developers can act on straight away, with evidence for every finding and retesting to confirm the fixes.
vapt.checklist: exposed admin panels and forgotten subdomains, weak authentication and broken access control, misconfigured cloud storage, and unpatched internet-facing software

soc.label: SOC
soc.subject: 24/7 security monitoring for {company}
soc.offer: Our Security Operations Center provides continuous monitoring, threat detection and rapid incident response, so suspicious activity is spotted and contained in minutes rather than days.
soc.deliverable: That means alerts triaged by certified analysts, clear escalation, and proactive threat hunting, without the cost of building a full in-house SOC.
soc.checklist: which log sources are actually monitored, how quickly an alert reaches a human, whether there is a tested incident-response playbook, and whether endpoints and cloud accounts are covered

grc.label: GRC
grc.subject: Compliance readiness for {company}
grc.offer: Our GRC team helps organisations align with standards such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS and SOC 2, and manage risk in a way that produces real audit evidence, not just paperwork.
grc.deliverable: We start with a gap assessment, then give you a practical roadmap covering policies, controls and evidence collection.
grc.checklist: scope and asset inventory, risk assessment, access-control and logging evidence, vendor risk, and incident-response documentation

audits.label: Security Audits
audits.subject: Independent security audit for {company}
audits.offer: Rynex Security conducts comprehensive third-party Security Audits covering cloud infrastructure, network architectures, and IAM access controls to identify hidden security gaps.
audits.deliverable: You receive a prioritized, executive-ready technical audit report detailing architectural weaknesses, cloud misconfigurations, and an actionable remediation roadmap.
audits.checklist: cloud IAM permissions, exposed storage buckets, perimeter security configurations, database encryption, and vendor access

trainings.label: Cyber Security Trainings
trainings.subject: Cyber security awareness & phishing training for {company}
trainings.offer: Rynex Security provides interactive Cyber Security Awareness Training and simulated phishing exercises designed to turn your employees into a human firewall against social engineering.
trainings.deliverable: Your team gets realistic simulated phishing campaigns, benchmark risk scores, and role-based training modules that reduce employee click rates.
trainings.checklist: phishing simulation resilience, credential protection habits, secure remote work hygiene, and incident reporting speed

general.label: General security
general.subject: Quick question about security at {company}
general.offer: Rynex Security helps organisations find and fix real security weaknesses before attackers do, through penetration testing (VAPT), 24/7 SOC monitoring and GRC / compliance support.
general.deliverable: You get certified professionals with an offensive-security mindset, a sharp focus on the risks that matter, and clear, actionable reports.
general.checklist: exposed admin panels and forgotten subdomains, weak authentication, misconfigured cloud storage, and unpatched internet-facing software

size_lines.small: We work with lean teams, so engagements are scoped to fit your size and budget.
size_lines.medium: For a team of your size, we can start with a focused, time-boxed engagement and expand from there.
size_lines.large: For larger environments, we plan around your existing tools and teams so testing and monitoring fit your current processes.

industry_pitches.fintech: For fintech and payment companies, one exploitable flaw in an API or web app can mean exposed customer data and failed audits.
industry_pitches.bank: For financial institutions, penetration testing, SOC monitoring and regulatory-aligned GRC support need to work together so findings turn into fixes and audit evidence.
industry_pitches.health: Healthcare organisations hold some of the most sensitive data there is, and their applications and integrations need to be tested the way a real attacker would.
industry_pitches.e-commerce: For online stores, checkout flows, customer accounts and payment integrations are prime targets for attackers.
industry_pitches.software: For software teams, web apps, APIs and cloud setups are the main attack surface, and customers increasingly ask for proof of security.
industry_pitches.telecom: Telecom environments have a large, complex attack surface that benefits from continuous monitoring and regular testing.
industry_pitches.default: Whether you are preparing for a compliance audit, launching a new product, or simply want to know how an attacker would see your systems, it helps to find the weak spots first.
